anomalies.observed: No administrative boundary could be matched for 'Western Rural' in SLE: "no unit named 'Western Rural' in SLE at levels (1, 2, 3). level 1: not found among 4 units; level 2: not found among 14 units; level 3: not found among 153 units. Closest by first
anomalies.handling: The area of interest falls back to an envelope around the retrieved records, padded by a fixed margin.
anomalies.consequence: Population from neighbouring districts may be counted in the denominator, and parts of the district with no recorded points may be excluded. Coverage shares are for the envelope, not the district.

anomalies.observed: status_clean is not two-valued in this district. Values present: Non-Functional (3,234); Functional, not in use (1,137); Functional (4); Abandoned/Decommissioned (3); Non-Functional, dry season (3); Functional, needs repair (1).
anomalies.handling: Serving status is read from the status_semantics block in handbooks/wpdx.yaml, which treats Functional and Functional, needs repair as serving and everything else as not serving.
anomalies.consequence: An equality test against the string Functional would score every point in this district as not serving and inflate the gap.

anomalies.observed: 3 records carry a status string not listed in the handbook.
anomalies.handling: Treated as not serving, which is the conservative reading.
anomalies.consequence: The gap may be overstated by up to these records.

anomalies.observed: The median record in this district is 6.6 years old (oldest 13.0 years, newest 0.6 years).
anomalies.handling: Age is reported, not filtered. Uganda district holdings range from a mean of six to over sixteen years, so a staleness filter would delete whole districts rather than clean them.
anomalies.consequence: Coverage figures describe the surveyed state of the network, not necessarily its state today.

anomalies.observed: 605 of 4,987 returned records were removed: flagged duplicate by WPdx.
anomalies.handling: Removed before any coverage computation, per the cleaning rules declared in the handbook.
anomalies.consequence: Coverage computed on the raw response would count these records twice or count superseded observations.

exhibits.title: Population surface
exhibits.supports: The denominator for every coverage figure in this bundle
exhibits.method: National 100 m grid, read over the area of interest and aggregated into blocks. The aggregation is coarser than the source and finer than the service radius, so it does not bias coverage.

rows: Population in the area of interest

blocks.text: population year 2020; 217,500 source cells at ~100 m read over the window, aggregated 5x5 into 8,700 cells of ~500 m

exhibits.title: Coverage before any intervention
exhibits.supports: The size of the gap the recommendation is trying to close
exhibits.method: A demand cell counts as covered when it lies within 1000 m straight-line walking distance of a point recorded as serving. Coverage is the union over serving points; a per-point sum would double count every settlement reachable from two of them.

blocks.caption: Serving and non-serving points over the population surface. Warm shading is population beyond the service radius.

exhibits.title: Candidate sites considered
exhibits.supports: That the recommendation was selected from a stated, reproducible set
exhibits.captured: Constructed from Ex01 and the area of interest
exhibits.method: Two kinds of candidate: an existing point recorded as not serving, which could be rehabilitated, and a regular lattice of greenfield locations. Lattice points already inside an existing service area are removed before selection.

exhibits.title: Selection method and its guarantee
exhibits.supports: That the ranking is reproducible and its optimality is bounded
exhibits.method: Candidates are scored by the population they would newly bring inside the service radius and selected greedily. On a monotone submodular coverage function greedy selection is within a factor of 1 - 1/e, about 63 per cent, of the optimum. The exact integer programme is not used in the loop: it takes minutes at district scale where greedy takes seconds, and every planner override triggers a re-solve.

blocks.caption: Marginal and cumulative population covered. The first site reaches 70,312 people, the last 44,478.

exhibits.title: Recommended sites
exhibits.method: Sites in selection order. Each row's coverage is additional to every row above it, so the programme must be built from the top down. Coordinates are WGS 84.

exhibits.title: Planner overrides and what they cost
exhibits.supports: That the recommendation was reviewed by a person, and where it was overruled
exhibits.method: Each override was applied on its own and the plan re-solved, so every decision carries its own cost rather than one lumped figure. Overrides are never blocked. A veto removes an area, not a single lattice point, because a planner saying not there means a place.

exhibits.title: Safety gate decisions
exhibits.supports: That access, transfer and fallback decisions were taken deliberately
exhibits.captured: Recorded at the point of each decision
exhibits.method: A gate never silently permits. Each row is a point at which the run either proceeded and recorded why that was safe, or refused. A refusal removes a source from the analysis and is stated here rather than left for the reader to infer from a missing figure.

exhibits.title: Scoring review
exhibits.supports: That the account was scored against a stated floor before issue
exhibits.captured: Computed by a reviewer that reads only this bundle's results file
exhibits.method: The reviewer receives the results file and nothing else: not the solver, not the code path, not the override reasons. It cannot score the intention behind the plan, only the account given of it. Every dimension carries a floor and the weighted average carries a floor; the run is issued only when all are met, or when a person forces it and that is recorded.

data adequacy.asks: Are the sources authoritative, current enough for the claim, and sufficient in coverage for the area of interest?

method fitness.asks: Does the location model answer the question that was asked, and is its optimality bounded and stated?

spatial rigour.asks: Projected CRS, union coverage, aggregation sensitivity, boundary exposure, equity: are the required diagnostics present and passing?

accountability.asks: Does every figure resolve to a recorded retrieval, is every human override recorded with its reason and its cost, and are source anomalies disclosed rather than resolved silently?

actionability.asks: Can an officer act on this: coordinates, a ranking whose order matters, a stated basis per site, and honest limitations?
